scripts.dev:web: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts "[web] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/web run dev"
scripts.dev:tauri: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri dev"
scripts.dev:tauri:ios: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri ios dev --host"
scripts.dev:tauri:android: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android dev --host"
scripts.open:tauri:ios: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri ios dev --host --open"
scripts.open:tauri:android: dotenv run -- node scripts/use-server.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android dev --host --open"
scripts.build:tauri: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri build
scripts.build:tauri:ios: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri ios build
scripts.build:tauri:android: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android build
scripts.install:cli: dotenv run -- pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/cli build && cp apps/cli/dist/tiny-chat ~/.local/bin/tiny-chat
